sources.title: Best 14B Coding Models (2026): Ranked by HumanEval + VRAM
sources.snippet: A 14B model at 4-bit lands around 9-10 GB of VRAM, leaving room for context — small enough for an RTX 3060 12GB or a 16GB Mac, big enough to beat the 7B models on real refactors. What counts as a "14B coding model" (and what is faking it)? "14B-class" is a loose bracket, not a hard number.
